raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Agile Product Owner & business analyst with 20+ years of experience in Banking and Capital Markets. Specifically Accounts Origination Proven track record owning end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and backlogs for mission-critical financial platforms.
Hands-on expertise in BPM-driven automation, AI/GenAI integration, compliance controls, and Agile delivery (SAFe, Scrum). Deep experience aligning engineering teams and stakeholders to deliver scalable, audit-ready, and resilient platforms across wealth management and retail banking domains. Holds CSPO, A-CSM, CSM, AZ-900, and DBF certifications.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Banking and Capital Markets • Business Analysis & Requirement Engineering • Risk, Dependency & Impediment Management • Stakeholder Management & Alignment • GenAI / AI Automation
Agile Product Ownership • Scrum / Kanban / SAFe Delivery • Data Analysis, SQL (TOAD, SQL Server) • • Global & Cross-Functional Delivery Leadership JIRA & Confluence Proficiency
CAREER TIMELINE
Wells Fargo Tata Consultancy Services Infosys Technologies Value Labs
Sr. AVP Associate Consultant Technology Analyst Management Trainee
2022 – Present 2011 – 2022 2006 – 2011 2005 - 2006
TOP ACCOMPLISHMENTS & HIGHLIGHTS

Led strategic modernization of bank’s Auto Loan Platform from Unisys led mainframe system to cloud native, API driven
system with projected ~$20M annual maintenance saving and $100M business growth.
Orchestrated migration of 5 mission-critical applications from PCF/TKGI to PCF achieving 99.95% SLA, ~50% platform cost
reduction, 2X deployment speed, 70% lower API latency

Pioneered the transformation of customer communication from paper-based automated digital - scaling from 12 to 30+
letters and statements across ~ 3M accounts. driving an estimated $500K savings.

Stabilized an unstable DWH during a major Enterprise Transformation through product ownership, SAFe-governed delivery,
and business-prioritized remediation — removing instability, achieving zero defect leakage, zero failed changes.

Led the modernization of a fragmented cross-country DWH ecosystem into a centralized AML and Sales Analytics platform,
reducing annual infrastructure costs by 75% ($13.5M to $3.4M), processing time by 50% (12 hrs to 6 hrs),
workforce utilization from 55 to 25 FTEs
Delivering the Datamarts which doubled the MIS and ORP reports and increased the revenue by 800K increase by ~17%.

Led business analysis activities for consolidating litigation data from 30 heterogeneous source systems into a
centralized DWH, enabling streamlined legal operations and improved regulatory reporting in a span of 6 months.

Led the Direct Banking Solution to on-board customers through STP integrating the CRM and Core Banking systems reducing
the multi-step hopping to one step and achieving and opening account in less 5 minutes.

Independently analysed and implemented annual SWIFT messaging standard changes for the international banking platform of
a bank with zero service disruption and 100% compliance.

Achieved a zero defect UAT and defect free production rollout of the Engineers’ Exchange platform – the first project of
the career.
CERTIFICATIONS & CREDENTIALS
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) • Advanced Certified Scrum Master (A-CSM)
GenAI Overview for PM - PMI • Diploma in Business Analysis – TCS
Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
Diploma in Banking & Finance (DBF) - IIBF
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Wells Fargo | Senior AVP | Hyderabad
Mar 2022 - Present
Owned and prioritised product backlogs, aligning delivery with strategic business objectives and customer value.
Conducted customer interviews and collaborated on the discovery sessions.
Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for REST/SOAP APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines and mainframe-to-OCP migration initiatives.
Facilitated Scrum ceremonies, improving team velocity, delivery predictability, and continuous improvement.
Managed cross-functional stakeholders, dependencies, risks, and sprint metrics in JIRA to ensure transparent, on-time delivery. Participated in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision and drive measurable outcomes across iterative delivery cycles.

Introduced GenAI-based StoryWeaver tooling to accelerate backlog refinement, delivery insights, and sprint risk identification.
TCS | Associate Consultant | Hyderabad
Jul 2011 - Mar 2022
Led Agile delivery as Scrum Master and Business Analyst for global banking clients including Citibank, Lloyds Banking Group, and State Street Bank across enterprise data warehouse, data lake, and securities lending programmes.
Owned and prioritised product backlogs, translating complex business requirements into sprint-ready user stories and acceptance criteria and prepared the source-to-target mapping specs for the DWH loads and report data mapping.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies and drove continuous improvement across distributed cross-functional teams.
Managed stakeholder communication, governance, risks, dependencies, and vendor coordination across multi-geography engagements.
Delivered enterprise data platform and reporting initiatives, supporting data profiling using SQL and data governance, integration quality and regulatory compliance.
Coordinated UAT, defect management, and release validation to ensure high-quality delivery in regulated banking environments.
Infosys | Technology Analyst | Hyderabad
Jan 2006 – May 2011
Analysed onboarding workflows and identified integration gaps between CRM and Core Banking systems to enable seamless STP account opening.
Defined functional specifications, integration mappings, and business rules for CRM–Core Banking interface implementations.
Coordinated with product, development, and testing teams to deliver banking workflow enhancements and customer onboarding capabilities.
Validated message flows, customer creation logic, and account opening scenarios through functional and UAT testing.
Led annual SWIFT messaging compliance upgrades by analysing standards, updating specifications, and validating message formats.
Supported defect resolution, implementation readiness, and production rollout activities ensuring regulatory compliance and uninterrupted banking operations.
ValueLabs | Management Trainee | Hyderabad
Sep 2005 – Jan 2006
Contributed business development wing of the organization towards lead generation.
TOOLS
• TOAD
JIRA
Confluence • FIGMA
MS Office Suite
